conditions: Every current route starts at the observed worker position and ends at a frozen allowed map node.
An independent oracle checks corridor adjacency, enabled/nonclosed edges, stairs/accessibility, obstacles, active/unknown-sensor hazards and explicit initial egress without reentry.
Each changed guidance in a lineage has a strictly greater guidanceVersion; repeated equal versions must retain exactly equal guidance.
Every movement route has a positive routeVersion. A changed consecutive routed guidance in the same lineage advances routeVersion. No across-null routeVersion monotonicity rule is invented.
Every confirmation binds the latest preceding independently valid FOLLOW route in the same run/worker/incident/map/profile lineage and lies within the published tolerance of that route target.
A later new FOLLOW route may replace an earlier target only after the independent safety and identity checks; the implementation target alone is never the expected oracle.
Raw checkpoint target/intent, live target and reserialized target bind the independently checked route; optional floor/node metadata are exact on arrivalTargets only.
Worker and active incident current guidance agree. Immutable first guidance and prior history rows remain exact.
Scenario evaluation alone writes no worker-response receipt/audit and no received/displayed/spoken/understood/help/arrived timestamp.
No particular10.5s action is assumed: absent a newer independently valid route ending at the current position, CONFIRM_ARRIVAL is forbidden.
All persisted history run versions strictly increase; latest validated target metadata remains persistent until another independently valid route replaces it.
responseProbeDisposition: The C2 current-arrived rejection probe followed its overconstrained negative assertion and never executed. V2 removes that oracle-dependent probe and sends zero worker responses; it preserves all scenario/control operations and timestamps.
hazardOracleBoundary: Route safety is independently computed against observed hazard polygons; this case does not independently regenerate equipment hazard geometry. Geometry correctness remains the separately bound baseline scope.

clock.actualUtc: Captured separately using the parent real-clock helper. Original C2 virtualClock labels are preserved verbatim.
